title: Ajoke POS
tagline: Point of sale for modern shops. Works offline, syncs online.

Ajoke.note: Yoruba Àjọkẹ́ (Ah-jó-ké): low a, open o, open e on a high tone. Use { "say": "..." } for a respelling instead.

scenes.caption: Ajoke POS - point of sale for modern shops
scenes.narration: Meet Ajoke POS. A complete point of sale and back office for shops, supermarkets, cafes and pharmacies. It runs on your own computer, works without internet, and can sync to the cloud when you are online.

scenes.caption: Install on your shop computer, then activate it
scenes.narration: Install Ajoke POS on your shop computer. The first screen shows a code for that computer. Send it to your provider, and paste the activation code you receive.

scenes.caption: Create your business in one page
scenes.narration: Next, create your business. Enter its name, choose your currency and sales tax, and set up the owner account with a password and a quick PIN.

scenes.caption: Your staff ID signs you in
scenes.narration: Your business is ready. Write down your staff ID. You sign in with it and your password, or with your PIN.

scenes.caption: Today's sales, profit and alerts at a glance
scenes.narration: The owner dashboard shows today's sales, tax, profit and average sale at a glance, with hourly trends and low stock alerts.

scenes.caption: A fast POS terminal with product pictures
scenes.narration: The POS terminal is built for speed. Browse by category, search, or scan a barcode. Stock left is shown on every product.

scenes.caption: Tap to add items - totals and tax update instantly
scenes.narration: Tap products to add them to the sale. Quantities, discounts, tax and the total update instantly.

scenes.caption: Cash, card, transfer or customer credit
scenes.narration: Take payment by cash, card, transfer, or customer credit, even split between methods. Then print the receipt, or send it by WhatsApp.

scenes.caption: A clear printed receipt
scenes.narration: The printed receipt shows your business details, every item, the tax, and how the customer paid.

scenes.caption: Every sale, with its receipt
scenes.narration: Every sale is saved with its receipt. Search all your history, reprint, and handle refunds and voids, with a manager's approval.

scenes.caption: A credit note for every refund
scenes.narration: When money goes back to a customer, print a credit note against the original invoice, with the tax reversed.

scenes.caption: Manage products, prices and categories
scenes.narration: In the catalog, manage your products, prices, costs and categories, with pictures and barcodes.

scenes.caption: Add a product in seconds
scenes.narration: Adding a product takes seconds. Leave the SKU blank and one is made for you, and the barcode is optional.

scenes.caption: Bring your products in from Excel
scenes.narration: Moving from another system? Import products, customers and opening balances straight from an Excel sheet. Every row is checked first, and nothing is saved until you confirm.

scenes.caption: Stock, suppliers, deliveries and expiry dates
scenes.narration: Inventory tracks stock in every branch. Receive deliveries from suppliers, record their invoices and payments, track expiry dates, count stock, and move it between branches.

scenes.caption: Customers, loyalty points and credit accounts
scenes.narration: Keep customer records, loyalty points, and credit accounts with limits, so trusted customers can buy now and pay later.

scenes.caption: A statement of account for each customer
scenes.narration: Print a statement of account for any customer, showing every credit sale and payment, the balance due, and how long it has been owed.

scenes.caption: Price it on paper before you sell it
scenes.narration: Need to send a price first? Make a quotation or a proforma invoice from your catalogue, priced exactly like a sale, with tax.

scenes.caption: A professional quotation
scenes.narration: Print it, or save it as a PDF to send to your customer.

scenes.caption: Every quotation in one place
scenes.narration: Every quotation is kept in one place: open, accepted, sold, or expired.

scenes.caption: Sell the quotation with one tap
scenes.narration: When the customer is ready to buy, one tap puts the quotation into the till, and it is marked as sold when the payment goes through.

scenes.caption: Open, count and close the cash drawer
scenes.narration: The cash register keeps every till honest. Open with a float, record cash in and out, and count the drawer when you close.

scenes.caption: Track business expenses
scenes.narration: Record business expenses, with any tax included and any withholding tax deducted, so your profit figures are always real.

scenes.caption: Clear reports for any period
scenes.narration: Reports show sales, profit, tax, payments, best sellers and staff performance for any period. Export them to a spreadsheet, or print them.

scenes.caption: Who owes you, and who you owe
scenes.narration: See who owes you and for how long, split into thirty, sixty and ninety days, and which supplier invoices are due or overdue.

scenes.caption: VAT return and withholding tax
scenes.narration: At the end of the month, the VAT report shows the tax you charged on sales, less the tax you paid on purchases, and the withholding tax to pay to the tax office.

scenes.caption: Send your books to the accountant
scenes.narration: Your accountant gets the month's books in one click, as Tally import files or a spreadsheet day book, so nothing needs to be typed in twice.

scenes.caption: Each staff member has their own login
scenes.narration: Every staff member gets their own sign in, so you always know who did what.

scenes.caption: Decide exactly what each role can do
scenes.narration: Roles decide exactly what cashiers, managers and other staff are allowed to do.

scenes.caption: Big discounts and refunds need a manager
scenes.narration: Sensitive actions, like large discounts, refunds and cash withdrawals, wait for a manager's approval.

scenes.chapter: Branches, sync and the Android app
scenes.caption: One business, many branches and tills
scenes.narration: Run several branches and tills from one system.

scenes.caption: Works offline, syncs to the cloud, connects tablets
scenes.narration: Ajoke POS keeps working when the internet is down. When you are online, it syncs with your cloud server, and connects Android tablets on your shop Wi-Fi. The owner can follow every branch from the Android app on their phone.

scenes.caption: A full audit trail
scenes.narration: A full audit trail records every important action.

scenes.caption: Your business, your currency, your receipt
scenes.narration: In settings, choose your currency from over forty, set your tax, payment methods, receipt message, and the ledger names your accountant uses.

scenes.caption: Quick sign-in with a staff ID and PIN
scenes.narration: Each day, staff sign in with their ID and a six digit PIN. Ajoke POS signs out by itself when left unattended.

scenes.caption: Ajoke POS by Ajoke Code Sphere
scenes.narration: Ajoke POS, by Ajoke Code Sphere. Contact us on WhatsApp to get started.
